candidate.user_submission: Pikin na 18 months old. E get cough or e dey breathe waka. E nor get diarrhoea. E nor get ear wahala. E nor get fever. Dem nor see convulsion dey happen now. E never get convulsion before. E nor dey weak or e nor dey like person wey don loss sense. E fit drink or suck breast. E nor dey vomit everything wey e chop. Dem count how e dey breathe for one minute. E chest nor dey sink inside. Di pikin nor calm as dem dey check am. E dey cough for 3 days now. Pulse oximeter nor dey available. E nor dey wheeze. E nor dey get wheeze wey dey come back. E nor dey get stridor when e calm. E dey breathe 35 times for one minute.
